name: Muqun
author: ryuhzk
description: Watch and answer the coding agents on your other machines, and open a real terminal on any of them, from the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Agent status across every host you reach over SSH, with the pane that is asking and a box to answer it in.

schema.label: SSH hosts
schema.description: Colon-separated ssh destinations to watch, for example you@machine:build-box. They can also be added and removed from the plugin window itself. Each one is asked what it has; herdr and tmux are found, not configured.

schema.label: Simfarm URL
schema.description: Where simfarm is reachable, e.g. https://your-mac.tailnet.ts.net:8801. Leave empty to hide the simulators button.

schema.label: Simfarm SSH host (only for plain http)
schema.description: An ssh target for the Mac, used to tunnel a plain http simfarm so the panel loads from a secure origin. Not needed when the URL is https.

schema.label: Local port for the simfarm tunnel
